design: Paired independent certified-state admission snapshots, not online policy simulation
new_tenant_payload: Full nominal floor(650*q/106)*window length; staged chunks exactly proportional to remaining service slots
future_arrivals: Independent seeded token buckets, capacity sigma+rho, replenishment rho; one original item per nonzero stream/slot
eligibility: Unchanged complete initial critical calendar passes production certificate and independent dense oracle and ledger capacity; all failures retained without resampling
primary_metrics: full on-time tenant bytes per offered snapshot
complete decision time excluding input/output and independent oracle
timing: C++ steady_clock; each full policy decision, excluding shared initial-state validation and independent postdecision oracle; host timing is descriptive not a bound
inference_unit: Seed, with four equally weighted boundary strata and four offers each; 2000 paired seed bootstrap replicates
limitations: One new request per independent snapshot
Byte-preemptive exact service, no host or radio execution
Replacement-capable interface is available to all controls; controls deliberately retain the committed plan
Older jobs cross new activation/return; new jobs start at their own activation and end at their own return
No headroom forecast, learned policy, future trace access, or demand-oracle admission
No claim that these declared traffic contracts represent all industrial deployments
